name: Gange Cha Yamune Chaiva
text:
गङ्गे च यमुने चैव गोदावरि सरस्वति ।
नर्मदे सिन्धु कावेरि जलेऽस्मिन् सन्निधिं कुरु ॥
meaning: May the sacred waters of Ganga, Yamuna, Godavari, Saraswati, Narmada, Sindhu and Kaveri be present in this water.
purpose: A prayer invoking the sacred rivers, said over water before worship or bathing.
when: Over a vessel of water before a practice.
note: Its place on Wednesday is from the client list, not a weekday rule.
